title: MemHarness — paper view
subtitle: The mechanism as Wu et al. describe it: a unified policy pi_theta that retrieves, critiques-and-reconstructs, then acts, cold-start SFT'd before episode-level GRPO. Lane = canonical stage (METHODOLOGY-SKELETON SS2.2); B3/B5 are the only empty lanes.
source: Wu et al. 2026, MemHarness (arXiv:2607.28272)   ·   every anchor re-located in Wu-2026-MemHarness.txt during verification
legend_notes: Cold-start SFT (SS4.1 / Appx A.4) is a full offline training phase before RL ever starts — both original architecture docs skipped it entirely; drawn here feeding the GRPO node in A6.

MemHarness fills A6 INTERNALIZE while ALSO keeping the full B1-B2/B4/B6-B8 retrieval pipeline — unlike TransMem/LiveMem/Memory Decoder, it does not trade retrieval away for parameterization; it does both with one shared policy.
B1 CUE is degraded because the paper never settles on one retrieval-trigger policy: SS3.2 frames it as a per-step agent decision, Appendix A.3 says retrieval happens "at each step" unconditionally.

P-UTILITY appears twice by design: once in A3 (episode-outcome success/fail counting that feeds the pruning threshold) and once in B4 (per-retrieval-hit usage counting) — the same Laplace-smoothed score, written from two different triggers.
